scope.test: SeedTool Real WebGL Engine & Overlay Integration > applies 0.25x zoom steps and resets to 1x on the actual canvas stage

trigger: The test selected an image and immediately clicked the Zoom In control before observing the real Seed canvas become visible.
propagationPath: file input -> Image.onload -> setImage/setZoomLevel(1) -> React commit -> canvas becomes visible; the test clicked Zoom In before that readiness boundary was observed, allowing the asynchronous image-load reset to race with the user action in Firefox.
violatedInvariant: Browser interaction assertions must begin only after the UI state they exercise has crossed its observable readiness boundary; fixed delays and timing assumptions are not valid synchronization.
observableSymptom: Firefox remained at 100% after the Zoom In click and timed out waiting for 125%; Chromium and WebKit passed the same assertion.

evidence.reproductionBoundary: The test already had an established canvas readiness helper in loadSeed(); the failing overlay test bypassed that boundary.

repair.mechanism: Await the actual Seed canvas visibility immediately after setting the file input and before interacting with or asserting the zoom overlay.
repair.regression: The existing 0.25x zoom sequence remains unchanged and now starts after the real canvas readiness boundary.

verificationPlan: Certification on the exact resulting main SHA
